Statement: Pretraining improves noisy-sound classification on small data (EfficientNet-B0 ImageNet vs scratch, mean F1)
Noise augmentation raises −5 dB macro-F1 while costing < 2 pp on clean audio (SE-CRNN)
Attention pooling improves robustness at −5 dB vs mean pooling (SE-CRNN)
Models trained with white noise lose accuracy on unseen pink noise at the same SNR (AST (AudioSet, frozen) + trained head, white 0 dB − pink 0 dB)
Evidence (test, paired by seed): Δ = -0.3 ± 0.7 pp, 95% CI [-2.1, 1.6]; pink < white in 5/7 models
